title: Commit window aligner and thresholded utilization-signature exporter
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: Dedicated fleets sometimes oscillate when reservation adjustments are applied mid-window and when sampled utilization signals disagree across pools. Customers see transient SLA blips during aggressive commit rebalancing (notably under variable traffic patterns from bursty tenants). This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a commit-window aligner that delays and groups reservation adjustments to commit boundaries to reduce churn and enable amortized scale decisions; 2) a thresholded utilization-signature exporter that emits compact, percentile-aware utilization sketches (HDR-based) per-pool and per-tenant window, enabling the autoscaler and the headroom controller to make decisions from smoothed, robust signals. Goals: reduce reservation churn, lower scale-up/scale-down reversals, and improve telemetry fidelity for long-tail utilization so that autoscalers can tune headroom with fewer false positives. Changes: - New controller commit_window_aligner (pkg/autoscaler/aligner) which buffers reservation deltas and applies them at commit window boundaries with configurable alignment tolerances and safety backoff. - util_signature proto and exporter (pkg/telemetry/util_signature) that samples per-slot utilization and exports HDR sketch summaries + checksum-based signatures to the telemetry pipeline. - Autoscaler integration: autoscaler now consumes util_signature summaries to compute trimmed percentiles (p50/p90/p99) and uses commit-window-aligned deltas when making scale decisions. - Backwards-compatible flags: feature gating via runtime flags to enable progressive rollout per-cluster. - Tests: unit tests for alignment logic, integration test harness simulating bursty tenants (test/e2e/commit_alignment_test), and a perf microbench for exporter overhead. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2481) - [x] Proto + exporter implemented - [x] Aligner controller implemented with safety backoffs - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Benchmarks captured and added to CI (flaky benchmark isolated) - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout and config defaults noted Migration notes: default behavior preserves current autoscaler semantics when feature flag is off. Enabling the aligner on existing fleets will cause reservoir adjustments to be applied at the next commit window; customers with tight SLA margins should schedule rollout during maintenance windows. Related: design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-2481/commit-window-aligner-design; internal convo: #infra-autoscale.

2026-02-12 Ava Martinez: Added emergencyOverride boolean to aligner config and updated README with operational guidance. The override bypasses alignment but still honors safetyBackoff.
2026-02-13 Priya Nair: Tests look good but observed a flake on CI perf benchmark (util_signature exporter). Can we limit sampling rate in CI and add a tolerance?

release_notes: Introduce commit-window aligner to reduce reservation churn and a thresholded utilization-signature exporter to provide robust percentile signals for autoscaling. Feature gated by aligner.feature_enabled; rollout recommended during low-traffic windows. Observability: new telemetry metrics util_signature.hdr_size and autoscaler.aligner.applied_windows.
notes: Performance impact of exporter measured ~0.7% CPU on busy pools (10k slots) — included in docs and nightly perf dashboards. Operational playbook added under docs/operations/commit-window-rollout.md
